title: digitalis purpurea subsp. mauretanica
intro: Digitalis purpurea subsp. mauretanica, commonly known as the Moroccan foxglove, is a subspecies of the Digitalis purpurea plant, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve heart function, and reduce symptoms of congestive heart failure. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis purpurea subsp. mauretanica are attributed to its ability to increase the force of heart contractions, slow the heart rate, and improve cardiac output, which is due to its bioactive constituents, including digoxin, digoxigenin, and digitoxin, among others. However, it is essential to note that this plant should only be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional due to its potential toxicity and interactions with other medications.
